The tutorial's IV briefing, verbatim in spirit: get a set of TPV coils for your EBF, have an Alloy Blast Smelter ready, and visit Mars, Phobos and Deimos. Also — 'you should've learned how to GregTech by now; if not, go clean up the machine craters in your base.'

MIAO's IV is short and sharp: the GTSR critical singularity stabilizer and the dense-steam overpressure system. Five quests, no filler.

The naquadah line starts here too — the tutorial calls its full processing too complex for IV, and offers the EBF shortcut: smelt NOM dust into naquadah nuggets, byproducts optional.
